sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 9B Defiant Fable is an Apache-2.0 multimodal fine-tune for reasoning, coding, creative writing, and roleplay. It retains the 256K context window and vision support of Qwen3.5 while reducing refusals. This default entry uses the NEO-imatrix Q4_K_M build with multi-token prediction enabled for faster generation. To install the model with the CLI, run: local-ai models install qwen3.5-9b ...
